title: Workers taken to hospital after FBI uses furnace to burn seized meth

title: After Bolsonaro’s Conviction, Brazil Already Considers His Amnesty
summary: Brazil’s top court sentenced former President Jair Bolsonaro to 27 years in prison. The nation’s Congress is already debating how to free him.

title: Political crisis rumbles in Serbia as duelling camps hold parallel rallies
summary: Antigovernment protests, which broke out more than 10 months ago, show no sign of abating.
